title: Throttled Workflow Engine with Priority and Rate Limits
prompt:
Fix the throttled workflow engine in workflow.py.

The engine executes tasks with dependencies, priorities, concurrency limits and token-bucket rate limiting. Tasks have states PENDING -> QUEUED -> RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED with strict transition rules.

The current implementation violates several scheduling invariants. Read the code and docstrings to infer the intended contract — this prompt does not exhaustively list edge cases. Fix the bugs so that all invariants hold without changing the public API (Scheduler, TokenBucket, FakeClock).

Key properties to preserve (non-exhaustive): state-machine validity, rate-limit burst cap, priority ordering, and failure propagation.
